title: Canonical graph extension into a compactification
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $u:U\to X$ a separated etale morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $c=(j,p)$ be a factorization $u=pj$ with $j:U\to Z$ an open immersion and $p:Z\to X$ proper. On constant-$A$ module sheaves let $E_u=u_{\Sigma!}$ be sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. Define a natural transformation $a_c:E_u\to p_*j_!$ as follows. Put $V=Z\times_X U$, $v:V\to Z$, $q:V\to U$ and $s=(j,1):U\to V$. The graph $s$ is open and closed. The unit for $s^*\dashv s_*$, the identity $s^*q^*\cong1$, and $s_*\cong s_!$ give $\pi:q^*\to s_!$. Compose the etale sum base-change isomorphism $p^*E_u\cong E_vq^*$ with $E_v\pi$ and the left-adjoint composition isomorphism $E_vs_!\cong j_!$. Transpose this composite under $p^*\dashv p_*$ to define $a_c$. Each comparison is fixed by the indicated adjunctions, not selected from an existence assertion. The scheme, morphism, and functor notions used here are those of [def-weil-open-immersion, def-pc-fibre-product].

lean.statement:
def etaleCompactificationGraphMap
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (u : U ⟶ X) [Etale u] [IsSeparated u]
    (c : Compactification u) :
    etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u inferInstance ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
